sources.summary: The API date selects an input/output compatibility contract; optional fields and new event variants may still be added.
Messages return assistant content blocks, model identity, stop metadata and usage; tool inputs are JSON objects.
Named JSON events describe message and indexed block lifecycles, cumulative usage and partial tool JSON.
UTF-8 lines dispatch an event at an empty line; incomplete data at EOF is not dispatched.
A protocol-valid stop reason can still mean the controlled task did not complete.
